notes: Two corrections. The supplied antecedent him of him whom man despiseth and him whom the nation abhorreth was given to the dependent noun rather than to the participial substantive it is the antecedent of, against rule 46 and against the chapter's own practice at 49.9, 49.10, 49.17, 49.25 and 49.26. And the waw of vayivcharekka was left unrepresented while who went to the verb, against rule 17's sentence giving the relative of such a recasting to the waw where no explicit subject pronoun stands.
